document_title: Process Characterization Plan — Small-Virus Retentive Filtration (Step 9)
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: Virus filtration sets no CQA; the QualityAttribute entities are the viral-clearance CQAs it controls/clears (cumulative, cross-step).
Per-step MVM/XMuLV log-reductions are modular contributions with no released spec; captured via StudyDesign.responses.
The Plan states classification is an OUTPUT; parameter_type left 'unclassified' here.

inventory.rationale: Title block declares document class 'Process Characterization Plan'.

source_references.quote: Document ID PCP-009 Document class Process Characterization Plan

process_steps.description: Small-virus retentive (size-exclusion) filtration: the dedicated virus-removal step. Retains virus larger than the membrane rating while the antibody monomer transmits. Sets no product-quality CQA; it contributes to the cumulative MVM (parvovirus) and enveloped-virus (XMuLV) log-reductions, credited as orthogonal/modular clearance under ICH Q5A(R2). The size of each contribution is what the planned study quantifies.

source_references.quote: The anion exchange pool is passed through a pre-wetted small virus retentive filter, the filter is chased with buffer to recover the product held up in the device, and the filter is integrity tested after use (SOP-2012).
the same membrane chemistry, the same retentive structure and the same housing geometry as the commercial filter
The clearance claim rests entirely on a scale-down model, because virus cannot be introduced into a manufacturing batch.
Cambridge, MA (Development)
Grafton, WI (Commercial DS)

The screening study is a full factorial in the 2 factors at two levels, augmented with 3 replicated centre points, giving 7 runs
The response-surface study is a face-centred central composite design in the same 2 factors, with 19 runs across the two stages and 12 runs in this one
Qualification will compare the small-scale system against commercial-scale data on three points: the flux profile through the load, product recovery, and the quality of the filtrate.

statements.statement_text: PCP-009 defines the characterization studies for the A-Mab small-virus retentive filtration step (Step 9), and it is written before any data exist.

source_references.quote: this plan defines the studies that will characterize it

statements.statement_text: Both process parameters (volumetric load and filtration pressure) are assigned to one multivariate design, and each characterization range contains the normal operating range and extends above it.

source_references.quote: Both parameters are assigned to the multivariate design, and each characterization range contains its normal operating range and extends well above it.

statements.statement_text: The study uses a two-factor full-factorial screen followed by a face-centred central composite design on a qualified scale-down model.

source_references.quote: The response-surface study is a face-centred central composite design in the same 2 factors

statements.statement_text: MVM sets the retention challenge for the step, because it is the smallest of the model viruses; XMuLV is larger and is expected to be retained with a wide margin.

source_references.quote: MVM is the smallest of the model viruses used for a monoclonal antibody process, and it therefore sets the retention challenge for this step.

statements.statement_text: The study will define the region of the two parameters over which the step meets its required log reduction for both model viruses.

source_references.quote: Define the region of the two parameters over which the step meets its required log reduction for both model viruses.

statements.statement_text: The two step-level clearance criteria are derived, not specified: each is the cumulative drug-substance requirement less the clearance credited to the other steps, so each moves if that credit changes.

source_references.quote: The two viral clearance criteria are step contributions and are derived, not specified.

statements.statement_text: The plan separates the two designs in advance: the screening design identifies the active factors and the response-surface model is the predictive model and the sole basis of the design space and the proven acceptable ranges.

source_references.quote: The response-surface model is the predictive model, and it alone is the basis of the design space and of the proven acceptable ranges in §8.

statements.statement_text: A clearance result below the limit of quantitation is censored rather than measured, so the model for that response will be fitted to the uncensored runs and the censored runs reported alongside.

source_references.quote: Such a result is censored, not measured, and a censored value cannot be treated as an observation in a regression without biasing the fit.

statements.statement_text: The step does not by itself satisfy the cumulative clearance requirement for either model virus, and the plan says so before the study begins.

source_references.quote: The step does not by itself satisfy the cumulative clearance requirement for either model virus
